1.consolidated_definition: Por la parte centroriental del país, se dice guineo gigante o amarillo a determinado fruto selecto, de tamaño ususalmente mayor que el corriente entre los productos bananáceos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In the central eastern part of the country, a certain select fruit, typically larger than usual among banana products, is referred to as giant or yellow guineo.
